data.name: Arctic Fox Virginia
data.shortDescription: Turns Virginia into a pagan arctic fox lady.
data.description:
Changes Virginia into an anthropomorphic / furry arctic fox, because

1. Humans are stinky and ugly!
2. Arctic foxes come from hyperborea and are therefore kino.

Walking animations may look a bit weird, as she no longer has extra limbs.

She has 5 outfits:

Swimsuit -> Tribal outfit
Leather Suit -> Tribal outfit no mask
Track Suit -> Dress
Dress -> Nordic gown
Camo -> Norwegian military uniform

Her shotgun model gets replaced with a Remington 870, because I hate how the sawed-off looks. When aiming though the gun seems to go to a weird angle, maybe I'll fix that later.
